lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2ZnSnS4 is tetragonal with space group I4mm (No. 143) and a 16-atom unit cell (Mg4Zn2Sn2S8) across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mg centers coordinated by six S neighbors, plus tetrahedral Sn and Zn centers with four S neighbors each. Corner-sharing between Mg octahedra and Sn tetrahedra is observed, with Sn–Zn polyhedra additionally showing corner and edge contacts. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
